text:
Alex M: paging — latency alarm for +50% p95 on inference-prod-gpu since 11:12 UTC, saw error spike to 5% on model-redwood-7b. can oncall confirm impact?
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT CREATED: #INC-2026-238 — High p95 latency and error rate on inference-prod-gpu. Severity: SEV2. Pager: @Priya N. Runbook: /runbooks/kv-cache-throttle
Priya N: I'm on it, looking at dashboard now. initial signal looks like KV cache size exploding on a subset of workers.
Danny R: saw similar earlier in canary, thought it was noise. posting quick prometheus query: `sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions[5m])) by (instance)` — evictions jumped 40x at 11:12.
Emilia T: logs show a sudden rise in speculative-decode draft targets being written: `spec_decoded_targets_written_total` up 30x. suspect interaction w/ continuous batching + KV cache write amplification.
Priya N: rolling mitigation: I'll throttle continuous-batching to min(1, current) and disable speculative decoding on prod group A. can we patch config via feature flag?
Alex M: +1 do it. prioritize limiting blast radius. call out alpha customers.
Sarah L: customer impact: two enterprise customers (acme-corp, medlytics) reported >5s tail latencies and transient 500s around 11:15. Support already opened tickets.
Priya N: applying hotfix flag now: `redwoodctl set-config --env prod --component batching --key continuous_batching_enabled=false --reason "emergency throttle"`
Danny R: seeing immediate drop in new KV writes on the effected hosts. p95 coming down but errors still elevated. posting small log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T11:14:22Z WARN kv_cache: write_amplification=48, size_mb=3024, evictions=1234
2026-03-15T11:14:47Z ERROR serve: speculative_decoder: write_failed, err=kv::oom
2026-03-15T11:15:01Z INFO batching: throttle_applied continuous_batching=false
```
Emilia T: disabling speculative decoding feature flag now to stop draft/target churn: `featurectl disable spec-decoding --env prod --selector region=us-west`
Oncall Bot: ACTIONS LOGGED: config change by Priya N at 1998882405, feature toggle by Emilia T at 1998882440.
Priya N: after both changes, p95 dropped to baseline within ~90s on most hosts. still watching for residual eviction churn.
Alex M: next steps — run a controlled canary re-enable with lower batch window and KV cache write cap; also need a postmortem runbook entry for draft/target sync hazards.
Danny R: quick mitigation note: we'll add a guard to speculative decoder to avoid writing draft targets if kv_cache_size > 2.5GB or evictions_rate > 100/s. creating PR now: `github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8342`
Sarah L: informing affected customers with ETA for full recovery ~30m, offering interim guidance.
Priya N: handing off to night oncall — @Sarah L will take the followup pack. leaving ops summary below.
Ops Runbook Bot: HANDOFF: SEV2 -> Night oncall. Summary: KV cache write amplification caused by speculative decoding + continuous batching interaction. Mitigations applied: 1) disabled continuous batching on prod group A, 2) disabled speculative decoding in affected regions, 3) created PR to add KV cache guards.
Sarah L: ack handoff. I'll monitor overnight, will reopen if error rate >1% or p95 > baseline + 30%. adding escalation to Eng SRE.
Alex M: thanks team. filing incident ticket and capturing metrics snapshot for postmortem.
Emilia T: capturing flamegraphs and kv stats; will attach to incident doc.
Oncall Bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: state=mitigated, severity=SEV3. last action timestamp=1998882699.
